name: Santa Cilia (Spain)
description: Blue field with a green triangle edged white with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with a white organ.
history: The town uses as its heraldic arms an oblong shield with a rounded base, semi-parted: first green with an organ and a lamb holding a cross with a flag.
